purpose: Defines what may execute as part of realpass. Gameplay and presentation behavior must be authored and owned by realpass; source mods are reference material only. Generic modding frameworks may provide plumbing but may not own realpass gameplay or presentation policy.

releaseExperience.note: Internal module gates may exist during development and acceptance, but a release build enables the complete accepted realpass experience as one product.

runtimeOwnership.frameworkRule: A framework may expose APIs, script loading, data loading, UI primitives or input plumbing. It may not supply the body, combat, injury, armor, presentation or progression behavior that defines realpass.
runtimeOwnership.referenceRule: Third-party gameplay/presentation mods may be studied and retained as provenance/reference records, but their scripts, archives, tweak payloads and assets may not be executed or packaged by an owned-runtime test or release build.

developmentRules: Internal modules may be independently gated to isolate faults and calibrate systems.
Development gates are not player preferences and must not become a release configuration menu.
A development candidate advertised as owned-runtime must fail closed if Dark Future or Project E3 is present in its deployment manifest.
Reference recipes may remain in the repository for historical provenance but may not feed the owned-runtime builder.
No source-mod save state may be required to initialize a clean realpass save/runtime.
releaseRules: The accepted body, injury, combat, armor, cyberware-physiology and presentation authorities ship together.
The release has one authored balance rather than exposing subsystem disable switches.
Accessibility controls may exist only when they do not change simulation authority or balance; traditional actor health bars are intentionally not part of the authored realpass presentation.
External gameplay/presentation mods are optional user choices outside realpass and are not prerequisites, bundled payloads or hidden runtime hosts.
Every runtime file in the realpass-owned payload must have explicit provenance.
